content.text: The grant clause meets the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: The licence grant satisfies the preferred position. § 13.1 extends the hosted-Services right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice gating needed, so we are above the fallback); § 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, including modification and contractor support rights; and § 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a permitted assignment under § 24 and bars Vendor from revoking or suspending a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. The licence is therefore not revocable at Vendor's discretion, and no redline is warranted. The § 13.4 use restrictions are standard and carve out law-permitted reverse engineering, authorized security testing, and use of Customer Data and output.
